title.zh: 授权为奎松省 Siain 入境港口的运营与维护拨款十七万五千比索的法案
title.en: An Act Authorizing the Appropriation of the Sum of One Hundred Seventy-Five Thousand Pesos for the Operation and Maintenance of the Port of Entry of Siain, Province of Quezon
title.orig: An Act Authorizing the Appropriation of the Sum of One Hundred Seventy-Five Thousand Pesos for the Operation and Maintenance of the Port of Entry of Siain, Province of Quezon

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1963/ra_3643_1963.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The sum of one hundred seventy-five thousand pesos is hereby authorized to be appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the operation and maintenance of the port of entry of Siain, Province of Quezon, during the fiscal year nineteen hundred and sixty-four. Such sums as may be necessary for its operation and maintenance in subsequent years shall be included in the annual General Appropriation Acts.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 22, 1963.
